description: Route each subagent to a Claude model and effort chosen from its task (model-effort-router).

hooks.command: for py in python3 python 'py -3'; do $py "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/route_agent.py" 2>/dev/null && exit 0; done; exit 0

for py in python3 python 'py -3'; do $py -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 9))' 2>/dev/null && exit 0; done; echo '{"systemMessage": "model-effort-router: Python 3.9 or later was not found on this machine, so subagents are not being routed. Install Python (python.org) and start a new session."}'
